To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of GM soy feed has a higher negative environmental impact in most impact categories compared to non-GM feed in a consequential life cycle perspective.
GM soy has the potential to be a more sustainable option than non-GM soy for the Swedish animal feed market.
GM and non-Gm soy have similar environmental impacts in ALCA, while GM soy has higher negative environmental impacts in CLCA due to increased production and substitution of locally produced proteins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
environmental impacts of the global soy trade and its effects on the Swedish feed chain.
the effects of segregation and market effects in the soy supply chain.
the environmental consequences of a possible policy shift towards GM soy feed in Sweden.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environmental impacts of soy imports are not significantly different for GM and non-GMs, but there is a risk of increased negative environmental effects if the demand for GM soy increases.
the environmental effects of GM and non-GMO soy are comparable, and the environmental consequences of a shift from GM to nonGM soy is negative in many impact categories.
there are no environmental benefits from using non-GM soy in Sweden.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the environmental impacts of soy production are very high and the environmental effects of GM soy are not significantly different than the non-GM soy imports to European Union.
the use of GM soy in compound feed has a larger environmental impact than the use of non-GM soy in Sweden.
there are no environmental benefits from importing non-Gm soy in Sweden.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the environmental effects of soy feed are not only dependent on the type of soybean, but are also dependent on the market effects that are triggered by a change in the soy type.
the environmental impacts of soy imports depend strongly on the market and trade dynamics and the environmental consequences of GM soy are not as straightforward as is often assumed.
the environmental impacts of soy production are not only a function of the production system but also depend on how it is consumed.
